headline: The documented round-down rule reproduces the six gold disputes exactly; the only defect is that the rounding doc is missing from required_documents.

issues.summary: The floor-rounding policy doc that decides which transactions are discrepant (doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007) is not listed in required_documents, so the golden_retrieval config, which inlines only required_documents and exposes no search tool, never shows it to the agent.
evidence: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007: "All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number. When calculating points earned on a purchase, the system always truncates (floors) fractional points rather than rounding to the nearest integer."
task_018.required_documents = [general_003, general_006, crypto-cash_back_001/002, business_platinum_001/002, ecocard_001/002, silver_rewards_card_001/002] (no general_007)
src/tau2/domains/banking_knowledge/retrieval_toolkits.py: KnowledgeToolsPlain 'Used by: no_knowledge, full_kb, golden_retrieval' (no retrieval tools)
issues.why_it_matters: In the golden_retrieval config, an agent that rounds half-up flags 22 extra transactions (for example txn_e45e7acb56a0, Amazon $89.99: 90 vs stored 89) and fails.

solution_check: Recomputed all 47 transactions for 890389b165 with Silver 4% Travel/Software else 1%, Crypto 2%, EcoCard 5x Green else 1x (Target/Walmart/Amazon/ThredUp excluded), and Business Platinum 4% Travel/Software/Media else 1.5%, flooring per doc_007. Exactly six mismatch, and they equal the gold set: Trader Joe's 95 vs 47, United 1390 vs 521, Patagonia 642 vs 128, Marriott 669 vs 167, LinkedIn Ads 2049 vs 768, Google Ads 750 vs 1875 (over-credit). Half-up gives 28 mismatches (22 false positives).
prior_note: The prior Major ('unwritten round down') was based on a missed document: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007 states the floor rule. What remains is a Minor required_documents omission.
notes: The persona says she does not want to access transactions herself and wants the agent to 'manage everything', but instruction 3 tells her to use any tool she is given, so the user-side dispute calls in the gold are reachable. Instruction 4 makes her insist on disputing the overpaid Google Ads transaction, which the gold includes. No discoverable agent tools are involved, so the verified scorer's relaxations do not affect this task.
